At run time, this case distinction code is identical to that which would be generated for a `Bool`-based conditional. In proofs, the tactic `decide` synthesizes an instance of `Decidable p`, attempts to reduce `decide p` to `true`, and then succeeds with the proof `of_decide_eq_true rfl` if it can.
